plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, the 4-date timeline completes: 14 Jul 1885 (Theodor Escherich discovers Bacterium coli commune / E. coli colonizing healthy newborn infants within hours of birth) · 1907 (Élie Metchnikoff proposes lactic-acid probiotics in Bulgarian yogurt) · 1946–1959 (Reyniers & Gustafsson raise germ-free isolator rodents, proving gut bacteria synthesize Vitamin K and harvest ~30% more dietary energy) · 28 Mar 2003 & 21 Dec 2006 (Jeffrey Gordon, Lora Hooper, Ruth Ley & Peter Turnbaugh sequence Bacteroides thetaiotaomicron's 261 fibre enzymes and prove the gut microbiome's metabolic & immune role; 2016 Sender & Milo census of ~38 trillion bacteria vs ~30 trillion human cells).

teach_overlay.detail: Animated 4-date timeline (1885 → 2016) alongside the dietary plant fibre → microbial fermentation → butyrate & immune T-cell regulation diagram
teach_overlay.scale: every meal you eat is a banquet for two — your human enzymes take the simple sugars up front, while thirty-eight trillion ancient microbial partners in the back turn indigestible plants into vitamins, fuel, and lifelong immunity
